scope: Linux ordinary sync and existing UI/backend contracts

ui_rendering.uses: shipped UI and response fixtures from real Tauri IPC tests

coverage: rejected command logging without argument values

live_coverage: upload/download content equality and bandwidth limits
one-way destination retention on source deletion
directory/extension/size filter changes retain existing files
local delete versus newer NAS edit
offline local deletion after snapshot restore
real socket disconnect and automatic reconnect
unsupported_or_not_exercised: Linux on-demand placeholders are unsupported and disabled; ordinary sync is used
vendor automatic update download/install not executed
system login/reboot and autostart launch not exercised
FN Connect relay/fnid not implemented; direct IP/hostname connections used
Kylin 2303/2403/3503, UOS1070 and ARM/LoongArch require native build/runtime validation
LAN mDNS device discovery on target customer networks not exercised; IPC routing tested
safety_bounds: Only dedicated fn-sync-qa NAS directories and temporary local files were modified by live tests; normal task files were not used as test fixtures

reproduce.live: Set FN_SYNC_TEST_DB, FN_SYNC_TEST_ADDRESS, FN_SYNC_TEST_REMOTE_ROOT to a dedicated fn-sync-qa directory; cargo test --lib -- --ignored --nocapture
reproduce.ui: Generate FN_SYNC_UI_FIXTURES via ui_task_creation_settings_logs_and_deletion_contracts, then node scripts/qa-ui-smoke.cjs
